fields.features_heading: What a Blank Request Sheet Never Checks
fields.features_subheading: A blank sheet asks for an item and a signature. These six pieces check the shelf and the budget before anyone approves.
fields.feature_1:
Items picked from your own catalog

Employees choose from a list you set, with the model and price shown on every item. A request for "a laptop" arrives as the exact machine IT stocks. Nobody writes back to ask which.
fields.feature_2:
Stock shown before anyone submits

The form reads the count for each item from the stock table. A crew lead sees what is on the shelf before asking, and an approved request takes its items out of the count.
fields.feature_3:
Allowances that total as people pick

Give each role a spending allowance. The form adds up every item as it is picked and shows what is left, and an order over the line is marked before it reaches the approver.
fields.feature_4:
Each item type goes to its owner

Send tool requests to the yard manager and laptops to IT. Each one gets an email or Slack alert showing the item and the reason, along with the date the employee needs it by.
fields.feature_5:
A record of what each person holds

Every approved request saves to a database you own, under the employee's name and the asset tag. When someone changes roles or leaves, the list of what they hold is ready.
fields.feature_6:
The codebase, exported to GitHub

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository, then connect the form to the asset system your IT team already runs. Host it next to the rest of your tools.

fields.tab_content_1:
Rotary hammers held for Thursday, 2 of the crib's 3

Ignacio Karsten runs a wiring crew at Brackenford Electric and needs 2 cordless rotary hammers for a job that starts Thursday. Before he sends the request, the form shows 3 on the tool crib shelf. The yard manager approves it, and tags RH-12 and RH-15 are held for a 6:30 am pickup at the yard.
fields.tab_content_2:
A monitor and chair for $429, inside a $500 allowance

Every remote hire at Merrowgate Analytics gets a $500 home office allowance. Analyst Anouk Feraday picks a 27-inch monitor at $189 and a desk chair at $240. The form totals her order at $429 and shows $71 left. It then goes to the office manager with her home address for shipping.
fields.tab_content_3:
No repair for a laptop past 3 years old

Oakhallow Tax Partners replaces any laptop older than 3 years and sends younger ones to repair. Priyanka Lund reports that her battery no longer lasts through a client meeting. She enters tag LT-0417, and the form finds a laptop bought 4 years ago. IT receives a replacement request instead of a repair ticket.
fields.tab_content_4:
When Emeric leaves, the one item still out is named

Copperlake Distribution records each item it issues by name. Picker Emeric Dovey's last day is Friday, and his record lists 4 items: a handheld scanner, a headset, a safety vest, and a locker key. Three of the 4 are checked back in. His supervisor, Gwendolyn Aske, gets an email naming the headset that is still out.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an Equipment Request Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create an equipment request form that checks stock, gets the right approval, and tracks every item issued.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List the items you hand out
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Ask for the reason and the date
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Connect the form to a stock count
fields.howto_step_1_des: Start with the items people ask for in a normal quarter, such as laptops and drills. Give each one a model and price, plus the person who approves it. That list becomes the catalog employees pick from, and anything off the list needs a reason.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask what the item is for and the date it is needed by. Keep the reason to one line. A crew lead who needs a drill for a Monday job should not have to explain it again when the request reaches the yard.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Keep a stock table with the count for each item, and let the form read it before a request goes out. An employee who sees an empty shelf can pick another model instead of waiting days for a no.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Name the approver for each item type, and set an allowance or a dollar line above which a second person signs off. Add a backup approver for the weeks when the first one is away.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Decide when a device is replaced instead of repaired, such as laptops past a set age. Record each asset purchase date next to its tag. The form then applies the rule as soon as an employee enters the tag.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Put the catalog and the approval rules into one prompt. Emergent builds the equipment request form, the database behind it, and a screen for whoever approves. To change a question later, say what should change in a new prompt.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Request a real item, then return it
fields.howto_step_7_des: Request a real item from your catalog and approve it, then check it back in. Confirm the stock count drops and comes back, and that the item shows up under the right person's name while it is out.

faq_plan.q: What is an equipment request form?
faq_plan.ref: What is an equipment request form?

prov.original: What is an equipment request form?

faq_plan.a: An equipment request form is what an employee fills out to ask for a tool or device the job needs. It names the item and quantity, with a reason and the day the employee needs it. The manager or team that owns the item approves it before anything is issued.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an equipment request form?
faq_plan.a: List the items you issue, the approver for each one, and any allowance or replacement rule. Put all of it into a single prompt for Emergent's AI form builder. Emergent builds the form and the database behind it, and every request lands in a table you own.

faq_plan.q: What fields should an equipment request form template include?
faq_plan.a: Start with the employee's name and manager, then what they need and how many, plus a needed-by date. Add a one-line reason and a field for the asset tag once the item is handed over. For anything that comes back, such as a loaner laptop, add an expected return date.

faq_plan.q: Should an equipment request form be separate from other request forms?
faq_plan.a: Yes, give equipment its own form. An equipment request needs a stock count and an asset tag, while a refund request form asks for money back and needs an order number. A shared form ends up asking every employee questions that do not apply to them.

faq_plan.q: Who should approve an equipment request form?
faq_plan.a: The person who owns the budget or the stock for that item. Send laptops and monitors to IT and tools to the shop or yard manager. Anything over a dollar line you set can go to a second approver. Name a backup for each approver for the weeks they are away.

faq_plan.q: How do you track items issued through an equipment request form?
faq_plan.a: Record the asset tag against the employee's name at handover. Each record then shows who holds the item and when it is due back. With Emergent, those records live in a database you own, sorted by person or due date.

faq_plan.q: Should broken equipment go on an equipment request form?
faq_plan.a: Only when it needs replacing. A repair belongs on a maintenance request form, with the asset tag and what is wrong. When the item is past your replacement age or cannot be fixed, the employee files an equipment request for a new one, and the old tag is retired.

faq_plan.q: Can an equipment request form show what is in stock?
faq_plan.a: Yes, when the form reads from a stock table. The employee picks an item and sees the count before sending the request. When the count is zero, the form can offer the next model or add the request to a waitlist. Emergent builds the stock table along with the form, from one prompt.

faq_plan.q: What is the difference between an online equipment request form and a paper one?
faq_plan.a: An online form saves each request the moment it is sent, routes it to the approver, and shows the employee its status. A paper sheet or an equipment request form PDF records the ask, and someone retypes it later. Forms built with Emergent have no response caps.

faq_plan.q: Can one equipment request form cover a whole team or project?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add a line for each item and a field for the job or project number, and the approver sees the full list at once. When the gear is for new work, file the project request form first and link the equipment request to it.
